title: Great Fire of Meireki destroys most of Edo
summary: A fire fanned by strong winds burned for three days in Edo, the shogun's capital, destroying most of the city and Edo Castle's main tower.
reason: Edo was densely built of wood and paper, and a long dry spell had left it vulnerable.
significance: About 100,000 people may have died, and the city was rebuilt with firebreaks and wider streets.
